title: CheckboxConfig
description: Serializable configuration for the RibbonUI checkbox atom.

id.description: Stable checkbox instance identifier; also the native input DOM id.

label.description: Visible text that also supplies the checkbox accessible name.

checked.description: Controlled checked state rendered by the native input; the host owns the value.

name.description: Form field name for native form submission.

disabled.description: Whether native activation and focus participation are disabled.

required.description: Whether the field must be checked for native form submission.
